description: Maps the completed independent embedding specification, Lean two-state recurrence and exhaustive reference evaluator to the open fixed-first-root structural equivalence, view/index correctness, matching-family source refinement, scheduling, f64/Python semantics and source-level resource theorem. Proposes concrete proof interfaces without claiming them as completed.

related_resources.reason: MFCS 2018 Definitions 1–4, Lemmas 5, 9–14, Theorems 6 and 15; proof-obligation context.

Formulate semantic invariants for right-view IDs, top-two exclusions and matching-deletion families
